backgroundPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: seamless single panoramic background painting for a Unity pixel art RPG side-view dragon lair, a horizontal exploration area similar to a classic 16-bit ruined temple level.
Primary request: create a professional pixel art volcanic dragon lair environment WITHOUT the dragon, WITHOUT characters, for use behind separately animated sprites.
Composition: very wide landscape, 3:1 aspect ratio. Strict SIDE ELEVATION, camera looking horizontally at the cavern; no isometric or overhead view. One continuous walkable basalt ledge across the entire image, its top exactly at 77% down from top. The ledge remains flat from the left edge through 65% of the image. Two broad shallow stone steps at 65% and 68% lead to a resting dais, 4% of image height above the main ledge, covering the final right third. Keep the ledge surface empty, with room for a human sprite to walk left to right. On the far left a dim entrance tunnel arches behind the path. The right third is a majestic spacious dragon sleeping chamber: an EMPTY broad resting nest of scorched stone, a few scattered ancient coins and bones behind the walking plane.
Scene/backdrop: towering dark violet and charcoal basalt walls, angular stalactites, old broken carved pillars, volcanic rock strata, distant lava waterfalls and low orange magma glow behind the ledge. Lava is below and behind the safe walking surface, never cutting the path. Midground rocks surround the chamber. Large dark framing shapes at the outer edges, no foreground objects occluding the middle walkway.
Style/medium: hand-pixelled high quality 16-bit JRPG environment, original SNES fantasy aesthetic, consistent visibly chunky square pixels, restricted palette, crisp stair-stepped edges, cluster shading and sparse dithering. Rich readable silhouettes. Cool charcoal and aubergine shadows, muted rust rocks, amber lava highlights. No smooth digital painting, blur or 3D rendering.
Constraints: no dragon, no creatures, no people, no interface, no words, no labels, no text, no watermark. Not a concept sketch. A finished gameplay background. Maintain a continuous dry, solid traversable floor at the specified baseline.
spritePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent sprite atlas with THREE side-view exploration poses for the dragon in the reference image.
Input image 1 is a character design reference only. Preserve this dragon's bright red scales, cream segmented belly, ivory horns, claws and dorsal spikes, dark burgundy wing membranes, large heavy body, long curled tail.
Primary request: three distinct full-body states of the SAME red dragon, in a 3-column by 1-row sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent background. Equal-width columns and generous transparent gaps. No cell borders or labels. Each pose stays fully inside its own column. Each column uses the SAME anatomy scale and the same feet baseline at 90% image height. All dragon heads face LEFT toward an approaching hero.
LEFT COLUMN: deeply sleeping dragon curled on the ground, head resting over the front paws, eyelids firmly closed, mouth closed, wings folded tight, tail curled around the body, clearly asleep and peaceful heavy breathing pose.
MIDDLE COLUMN: dragon waking, opening a golden eye, lifting head and shoulders, front paws planted, wings beginning to unfold, transitioning from lying to sitting.
RIGHT COLUMN: dragon fully awake, sitting upright on four limbs, head lowered left toward the hero, both wings raised but fitting inside the column, alert golden eye and mouth open in a restrained roar.
Style: coherent original SNES 16-bit fantasy JRPG pixel art, crisp square pixels, dark outlines, grouped cluster shading, limited palette. Match the reference identity with cleaner, coarser game-ready pixel clusters. No tiny disconnected effects, no shadow painted behind the dragon, no flames, no Z letters. All poses fully visible, horns, tail and wings not cropped. Nothing except the three dragon sprites.
